First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @pedalthepeaks the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Pedal the Peaks Wednesday Shop Ride group ride

A Wednesday evening shop ride from a Main Avenue bike shop in Durango. Listed by the Durango tourism office; the shop's own site does not post the schedule, so call or check Instagram before you go.
